/klu gtor rgyas pa sbyin pa'i lang tsho nā ga me na ka zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: /klu gtor rgyas pa sbyin pa'i lang tsho nā ga me na ka zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bla ma dang mgon po nā gend+ra rā dza rig pa'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo// rig pa 'dzin pa gang zhig klu gtor shin tu rgyas pa bya bar 'dod na/ klu dbang rgyal po'i rjes gnang thob pas yid dang mthun pa'i gnas sam klu dang sa bdag gnas nges pa'i sar/ stan bde bar 'dug pa'i mdun du/ nas/ 'bras/ gro/ so ba/ sran ma ste/ 'bru sna lnga'i phye ma la/ klu sman gyis sbags pa/ dkar gsum/ mngar gsum gyis sbrus pa'i gtor ma zlum po sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka mang du g.yo ba'i rnam pa can no// ril bur byas pa rin po che'i snod gtsang mar bshams/ chu gtsang dkar gsum mngar gsum klu sman gyis sbags pa 'du bya/ klu thebs yod pa'i nyin mor bya ba don la gnas so// gzhan yang nyer mkho rnams tshogs par bya zhing*/ klu gtor gyi gong dang*/ de dag gi dus sha chang sgog btsong la sogs pa kha na ma tho ba'i bza' btung rnams spangs la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi sngon du btang la/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ snang grags kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad bden par ma grub pa'i ngo bo/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i gdan la/ rang rig hūm̐ yig dkar ser gsal ba las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid de bzhin gshegs pa klu dbang gi rgyal po sku mdog dkar po la mgrin pa yan chad sngon po/ mtshan so gnyis dang*/ dpe byad brgyad cus mdzes shing*/ phyag gnyis thugs kar klu thams cad ngan song las 'grol ba'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ sham thabs dang chos gos ngur smrig gsol ba/ 'od kyi tshogs spros pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas klu dbang gi rgyal po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/

oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ nas shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lhas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan dbang lha rnams rang nyid la thim/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i dbus su hūm̐ gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa la thim par gyur par bsam/ tadya thā/ oṃ ta thā ga ta bha ga wān nā ga rā dza a dhiṣṭha na a dhiṣṭha te swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzla ba ni bdag gi rnal 'byor ro// de nas/ rang 'phags pa klu dbang gi rgyal por gsal ba'i mdun du rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i skyed mos tshal chen po/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams ltar yangs shing rgya che ba rin po che'i ri bos bskor zhing*/ dpag bsam gyi shing dang*/ ne'u seng gi ljongs rnams su khrus kyi rdzing bus gang ba de rnams su bya skad snyan par sgrog pa/ ri dwags la sogs pa sems can yid du 'ong ba rnam pa sna tshogs pa rgyu zhing bde bar 'khod pa/ rin po che dang*/ sman dang*/ nags tshal dang*/ 'bru dang*/ rtsi sman longs spyod kyi dpal 'byor mtha' yas pas gang ba/ de dag gi dbus su rgya mtsho chen po sngo la dwangs pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ phyogs mtshams rnams su rin po che'i them skas kyis mdzes pa/ chu bya yid du 'ong ba sna tshogs pa rgyu zhing skad snyan sgrog pas gang ba/ mtsho de dag gi nang du dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor bu la sogs pa rin po che'i rigs rnam pa sna tshogs pas gang zhing*/ sbal sbrul nya dang chu srin rus sbal la sogs pa klu dang sa bdag gi rigs kyi dud 'gro dpag tu med pas yongs su gtams pa/

mtsho ngogs su padma dkar po la sogs pa'i chu skyes sna tshogs pa lang tsho dgod cing 'dzum pa/ mtsho mthar klu shing gi nags tshal rgya khyon tshad las 'das pas yongs su bskor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po'i dbus su paṃ las rin po che'i padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus dang phyogs mtshams rnams su phuḥphuḥlas dbus su klu yi rgyal po wa ru ṇa ston ka'i zla ba lta bu/ 'dab ma shar du mtha' yas dkar po/ lhor padma sngon po/ nub tu 'jog po dmar po/ byang du nor rgyas dkar po/ dbang ldan du padma chen po dkar po/ mer dung skyong dkar po/ bden bral du karko ṭa dkar po/ rlung du rigs ldan dmar ser rnams lha'i lus can thal mo sbyar ba sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka can/ smad sbrul mjug tu 'khyil ba/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ gtsug rgyan nor bu 'od 'bar bas mdzes pa/ de dag gi mtha' skor du/ klu rgyal rigs/ rje rigs/ bram ze'i rigs/ dmangs rigs/ gdol ba'i rigs rnams rang rang gi rgyal po btsun mo sras dang blon po 'bangs 'khor chung ma dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ de dag gi mtha' skor du sa yi lha mo brtan ma dang*/ sa 'dzin lag pa chen po la sogs pa sa bdag gi gtso bo rnams dang*/ gnyan gyi sde dpon rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba/ de dag gi mthar skor du stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams rnams su gnas pa'i klu dang sa bdag gnyan gyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad kyis yongs su bskor te char sprin ltar dkrigs par gyur/ oṃ nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes lcags kyu'i rgyas bkug /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes so sor bstim/ oṃ nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ nas shapada'i bar sbyar/ gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ni// sa 'og mun pa ma lus sel mdzad cing*// bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab// klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/

oṃ āḥwa ru ṇa ya hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥ.a nantā ya hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥpadmā ya hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥtakṣa ka ya hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥbā su ki ye hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥm hā padma ya hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥshaṅkha pā la ya hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥkarko ṭā ya hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ āḥku li kā ya la hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes dang*/ klu dga' bar byed pa'i phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ hi li hi li ma hā hi li phruṃ phuḥswā hā/ zhes brjod/ gtor snod chus bkang ba mche ba 'dzin pa'i rgyas/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐ gis bsangs/ rdo rje me'i phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ badzra dzwa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa mā tha bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa kyis gzi byin bskyed/ thal mo khog stong gi rgyas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba'i gtor ma dkar gsum rtsi sman rnam pa sna tshogs las byung pa'i longs spyod klu dang sa bdag gnyan la sogs pa thams cad kyi mkho dgu'i longs spyod bza' btung gi tshogs dang*/ rang rang gi nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar byed pa'i yo byad ma tshang ba med pa nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam par gyur par dmigs/ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ sarba bidyā pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā warta ya ā warta ya hoḥ lan gsum dang*/ a kā ro gsum dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ sambha ra'i sngags gsum gyi mthar thal mo bkan pa dbul ba'i rgyas/ oṃ nā ga rā dza lo ka pā la ka ra wa ru ṇa/ bā su kī māṃ/ ā nanta/ takṣa ka /karko ṭa| padma/ ma hā padma/ shaṅkha pā la/ ku li ka pā la/ de wa ti/ ma hā de wa ti/ sau ma shi khi/ ma hā sau ma shi khi/ daṇḍa dha ra/ ma hā daṇḍa dha ra/ a pā la/ hu lun/ nanda/ u pā nanda/ sā ga ra/ ma hā sā ga ra/ tapta/ ma hā tapta/

shrī kanta/ ma hā shrī kanta/ ratna kanta/ su rū pa/ ma hā su rū pa/ bha dra hi ka /ma ho ra ga /shī li/ ma hā shī li/ oṃ klu yi rgyal po 'jig rten skyong mdzad wa ru ṇa// mtha' yas nor rgyas 'jog po karko ṭa padma// pad chen dung skyong rigs ldan skyong ba lha mo dang*// lha mo chen mo zla ba'i thor cog thor cog che// dbyug 'dzin dbyug 'dzin chen po sog ma med hu lun// dga' bo nyer dga' rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po dang*/ tsha ba tshad chen dpal mdzes mdzes chen rin chen mdzes// gzugs bzang gzugs bzang chen po sbrul bzang lto 'phye che// bsil ba dang ni bsil ba chen po 'khor bcas rnams// oṃ bhakṣa bhakṣa/ ā gatstsha ā gatstsha/ ma hā nā ga a dhi pa te bhurbahu wa swa phruṃ phuḥswā hā/ i maṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes bdun gyis wa ru ṇa klu chen brgyad dang bcas pa la dbul/ slar yang*/ oṃ nā ga rā dza tsa tri/ nā ga na tri/ nā ga na pra mo na tri/ nā ga phru ta phu ra tri/ nā ga mu du na tri rā dza yo ṣi tā pu tra pa ri ṇa ka ya sa pa ri wā ra i maṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum dang*/ klu rgyal rigs rje rigs bram ze'i rigs/ dmangs rigs gdol pa'i rigs su gtogs pa thams cad kyi rgyal po btsun mo sras blon po 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim zhing dgyes par gyur cig /oṃ pa khrag swa te be sa be wa tri bhe wa rakṣa pri tri sa ga du tri rā dza yo ṣi tā pu tra pa ri ṇa ka ya sa pa ri wā ra i maṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum dang*/ sa bdag sa yi lha mo brtan ma dang*/ sa 'dzin lag pa chen po dang*/ gzhan yang sa bdag rgyal po dang*/ rgyal mo dang*/ blon po dang*/ blon mo dang*/ mthu chen dang*/ 'theng po dang*/ grum po dang*/ shel ba dang*/ zha bo dang*/ yon po dang*/ long ba dang*/ chag po dang*/ lag bskum dang*/

rkang gsum dang*/ sor mo mang nyung can dang*/ dal rgan can dang*/ rna ba can dang*/ 'on pa dang*/ mdze rigs bco brgyad dang*/ re re dang*/ gnyis 'dzom dang*/ gsum 'dzom dang*/ dmag dpon dang*/ khro bo dang*/ gshed po dang*/ rgur po dang*/ dgye bo dang*/ glen pa dang*/ lkugs pa dang*/ dig pa dang*/ drag po dang*/ gtum po la sogs pa sa bdag gi rigs su gyur pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim zhing dgyes par gyur cig /oṃ ku mā ra phu tri rā dza yo ṣi tā pu tra pa ri ṇa ka ya sa pa ri wā ra i maṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum/ gnyan gyi rigs su gyur pa me chu sa shing nam mkha'i gnyan dkar ser dmar ljang nag po la sogs pa kha dog khra bo can/ gnyan gyi rigs su gyur pa rnams kyang mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim zhing dgyes par gyur cig /ces dang*/ gzhan yang mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di mthong ba dang*/ thos pa dang*/ reg pa dang*/ khyer ba dang*/ zos pa dang*/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di btungs shing khrus byas pa tsam gyis bdag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum bag med pas tshor ba dang*/ ma tshor ba dang*/ shes bzhin dang*/ shes bzhin ma yin pas stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di dang*/ gzhan dag klu dang sa bdag gnyan gy-i rigs su gyur to cog gi rgyal po dang*/ btsun mo dang*/ sras dang*/ blon po dang*/ 'bangs dang*/ 'khor gyi tshogs drag zhan bar ma thams cad dang*/ de rnams kyi gnas dang*/ rten dang*/ nor rdzas dang*/ mkho dgu'i yo byad la sogs pa rnams la gnod pa dang*/ 'gal ba dang*/ 'tshe bar bgyis pas de dag thams cad kyi mgo la sogs pa'i yan lag dang*/ sor mo la sogs nying lag dang*/ snying la sogs pa'i don lnga dang*/ pho ba la sogs pa'i snod drug dang*/ sha khrag rus pa rkang rgyus chu ba la sogs pa nyams pa thams cad sor chud cing*/

lha'i lus skyon med cing phun sum tshogs pa nyid du skad cig gis sos par gyur cig |rang rang gi las kyi rnam par smin pa'i sdug bsngal dang*/ 'tshe ba thams cad myur du zhi zhing med par gyur nas/ nad dang sdug bsngal 'tshe ba la sogs pa'i ming tsam yang med pa rdzogs ldan gyi dus ltar bde ba skyid pa 'ba' zhig la longs spyod par gyur cig /de dag gi mthus klu dang sa bdag gnyan gyi rigs su gyur pa rnams kyis/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi thog drangs/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la shes bzhin dang*/ shes bzhin ma yin pas gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa thams cad med cing ci bsam lhun gyis 'grub pa'i sdong grogs rgya chen po byed pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces dang*/ lag g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon skyabs sbyin gyi rgyas/ oṃ nga ni klu dbang rgyal po ste// snying rje phan sems dag pa yis// de ring gtad med mchod sbyin bgyi// lan la mi re'i sbyin pa gtong*// klu yi rgyal po wa ru ṇa// mtha' yas padma 'jog po dang*// nor rgyas pad chen dung skyong dang*// karko ṭa dang rigs ldan te// gdengs can dbang po khyed rnams la// rang rang mthun pa'i 'dod yon dang*// skyed tshal longs spyod la sogs pa// mkho dgu'i 'byor pa deng 'bul gyis// bzhes la phan pa'i sems bskyed cig /khyed rnams ston pa'i zhal mthong zhing*// ye shes spyan dang ldan pa'i phyir// sngon gyi dam tshig dran mdzod la// phan pa'i mthun grogs deng sgrubs shig /rgyal rigs dkar po chu la dbang*// bsam pa'i dug rnams zhi bar mdzod// rje rigs ser po sa la dbang*/ /mthong ba'i dug rnams zhi bar mdzod| |bram ze dmar po me la dbang*// kha rlang dug rnams zhi bar mdzod// dmangs rdol nag po rlung la dbang*// reg pa'i dug rnams zhi bar mdzod// sa bdag rigs bzhi rang rang gi| |ci 'dra'i dug rnams hur thum gyis// bsod pa'i 'tshe ba zhi gyur cig

/gnyan rigs lnga yi yid kyi dug /gag lhog gzer nad med par mdzod// kyai/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// shes dang mi shes dbang gyur pa'i// klu gnyan sa bdag 'khor bcas la// 'gal gnod 'tshe nyams song ba rnams// de ring gso zhing bkang ba dang*// zhi bas bcos par bgyi lags kyi// klu chen rgyal por gyur pa rnams// rgyal ba'i zhal mthong chos thos pas// byams ldan 'gro la mi gnod kyang*// klu phran gzhon nu dregs pa can// nga rgyal dbang gis gzhan la 'tshe// sa bdag gnyan rnams khyod kyi 'bangs// bka' lung nyan cing de sgrub pas// de phyir khyed rnam nyams pa gso// klu dbang rgyal po'i thugs rje yis// rin chen skyed mo'i tshal gyi tshogs// klu rnams nyer 'tsho'i gzhir gyur cig /rgya mtsho chen po dwangs ba 'di// bya dang ri dwags la sogs pa// klu yi spyan gzigs dam par gyur// sbal sbrul nya la sogs pa rnams// klu yi nor du deng gyur cig /mdzes pa'i dkar gsum gtor ma 'di// mngar gsum 'o ma'i rgya mtsho bcas// klu yi gnod pa kun zhi zhing*// mthun pa'i rdzas su 'di gyur cig /dza ti pha la'i rdzas 'di yis// klu yi mgo nyams sos gyur cig /rgya mtsho lbu bas klad pa dang*// gzi yis mig nyams sos gyur cig /utpa la yis sna dang ni// nya lcibs 'gram pa nyams pa sos// li khris sha dang mtshal gyis khrag /le brgan dar gyis ljags dang ni// mgron bus so dang dung gis rus// gur gum gyis ni dri nyams sos// tsandan dkar pos tsha ba sel// rma bya'i mdongs kyis mdangs nyams sos// dar tshon lnga dang sbrul lpags kyis// pags nyams gso zhing snying zho shas// don snying nyams pa sos gyur cig /mkhal ma zho shas mkhal ma dang*// gla gor zho shas glo ba dang*// dbang po lag pas lag pa dang*// chu srin sder mos sder mo dang*// chag tshang ku bas grod pa dang*// spangs spos tshul khrims nyams pa gso// spu shel rtse dang rdo rgyus dang*// ras skud dkar dmar rdzas rnams kyis// rtsa rgyus chu rgyus nyams pa gso// sle tres rgyu ma byi tang kas// reg bya gso zhing a ru ras// nang khrol nyams pa sos gyur cig

/'dam bu ka ras brla rkang dang*// li shis srog rtsa sug smel gyis// mkhal ma nyams pa sos gyur cig |skyu rus mkhris dang ba ru ras// bad mkhris sel zhing ka ko las/ /pho 'tsher nyams pa sos gyur cig /tsandan dmar pos khrag tshad dang*// ga pur tshad pa kun sel zhing*| |thang lo smyug los yan lag gso// spos dkar chu ser tsha ba sel// se le ljangs pas skra smin ma// rin chen sna lngas bang mdzod dang*// dkar gsum mngar gsum btung ba dang*| |'bru snas kha zas nyams pa gso// gzhan yang gnas dang pho brang dang*// 'khor dang longs spyod nyams pa sogs// mthun pa'i rdzas kyis sos gyur cig /bdag cag dpon slob lus 'di ni// sha khrag mi gtsang phung po ste// ngag ni brag cha snying po med// sems ni gsal stong ngos bzung bral// de phyir lus ngag yid gsum las// lhag pa'i longs spyod deng 'bul gyi// klu dang sa bdag gnyan rnams kyi// shin tu khros pa zhi gyur cig /dbang po rnams kyi spyod yul du// mkho dgu'i longs spyod ldan gyur cig /klu dang sa bdag gnyan rnams kyi| |mkha' lding bye tshan 'jigs pa sogs// rang rang rigs kyi sdug bsngal dang*// nad dang ngan 'gro la sogs pa// gnod 'tshe thams cad zhi gyur cig /ngan song gnas las thar nas kyang*// tshangs pa'i tshe dang ldan pa dang*// chos spyod byang chub sems bskyed nas// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas dang*// mtha' yas sems can ma lus pa// klu gnyan sa bdag gdug sems kyis// bzung ba yod na de thong zhig /bcing ba khrol la bsdam pa lhod/ mnan pa khyog la sos par mdzod| |bdag gi lhag bsam stobs dang ni// de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin stobs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// klu gnyan sa bdag 'khor bcas kyi// gdug rtsub khong khro rab zhi nas// bsam pa chos bzhin 'grub par shog

/ces bsngo/ klu gnyan sa bdag rnams kyi sdig sgrib sbyang ba'i blos skabs 'dir/ kaṃ ka ni dang ngan song sbyong ba'i rtsa rig dang yig brgya rnams tshar gsum re brjod/ slar yang klu la bde ba sbyin pa'i gzungs/ nā ga rakṣa nas gsungs pa ni/ rgya gar du/ nā ga sarba su kha tsa ri nā ma dha ri ṇi/ bod skad du/ klu'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad la bde ba sbyin pa'i gzungs// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa klu yi dbang phyug rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// tadya thā/ dha ra ni dha ra ni/ utta ri ni/ saṃ pra tiṣṭha ti/ bi dza ya warṇa satt+ya pra tidzñā sa ra ha dzñā na wa ti/ uddhe sa dha ni/ bi na ma ni/ a bhi ṣe tsa ni/ a bhi bya ha ra/ shu bha ha ba ti/ a dzī ma dhu/ e hi kuṃ pa la ni/ ba hā ha ra ke shā nā dhu na pā paṃ sho dha ya/ marga na ni/ ri ha ka dharmā ta/ shuddha lo ka bi dhi ma ri/ rā dza sa du kha sha ma na/ sarba buddha a ba lo ka ni a dhiṣṭha te pradzñā dzñā na ye swā hā/ nā ga sarba/ sa kra sarba/ su me sarba/ traka rakṣa tsi ti su ma shu shu/ nag po shu shu/ sarba shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes bdun nam nyer gcig brjod// 'di'i phan yon gzhung las/ rang nyid sa ma dhi dang ldan pas gzungs bzlas te gtor ma byin na sems can thams cad la/ klu rnams kyi gnod 'tshe zhi ba dang*/ klu rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdug bsngal thams cad zhi zhing*/ de'i mthus grogs byed pa dang*/ sa bcud spel ba dang*/ thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad 'grub cing char chu dus su 'bab/ lo 'bras legs/ 'khrug rtsod zhi ba la sogs pa phan yon dpag tu med pa gsungs pas gzungs 'di shin tu gal che zhing gnad zab yin pa'o// de ltar zang zing dang byams pa dang*/ mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pas tshims par byas nas/ chos kyi sbyin pa ni/ kyai ma klu dang sa bdag gnyan// ma lus bdag gi ngag la nyon// thams cad mi rtag sgyu ma ste// gang la'ang snying bo ma mchis so// dkar po'i las la bde ba ste// nag po'i las la sdug bsngal 'byung*// chos rnams rgyu byung de 'gog pa// de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs// sdeig spangs dge bsgrub rang sems dul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag ste// zag bcas rnams ni sdug bsngal zhing*// chos rnams thams cad bdag med de// mya ngan 'das pa zhi ba'o// 'khor ba'i 'jig las skyob pa'i skyabs// sangs rgyas nyid la skyabs su gsol| |de sgrub lam ni dam chos te// lam grogs mthun pa dge 'dun yin// mtha' yas sems can bde ldan zhing*// sdug bsngal bral zhing de med pa'i// bder gnas nye ring chags bral ba'i// btang snyoms 'god 'dod bsam pa yi// smon sems bskyed cing de bsgrub phyir// gzhan la gnod spong bde ba sbyin// rang rang blo dang mthun pa yi// dam chos lam la 'jug par gyis// 'khor 'das byed po rang sems te// de yang mtha' bral zung du 'jug

/gsal stong bsal bzhag med pa nyid// yang dag la ni yang dag blta// de mthong grol ba don byang sems// skyabs sems sdom pa deng nas bzung*// de yi bslab bya srog bzhin srungs// sangs rgyas chos tshogs khams byang chub// yon tan sangs rgyas phrin las tha// rdo rje'i gnas bdun zab mo'i chos// klu gnyan sa bdag khyed rnams kyis// 'khrul ba med par rtogs gyur cig /ces byams pa'i sems kyis dam pa'i chos bshad la/ de nas 'di skad do// kye/ klu gnyan sa bdag 'khor bcas kyi// sku gsung thugs dang g.yog 'khor dang*// gnas rten nor rdzas bcas pa la// bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod kyis// gnod 'tshe phog thug gyur pa rnams| |de ring bskangs shing gsos zin gyi// de ring mthol zhing bshags zin gyi// de bas bdag cag 'khor bcas la// de ring nas ni byang chub bar// gnod cing 'tshe ba'i sems bor la// phan grogs bsam don myur sgrubs shig /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i tshogs rnams la// gnod cing 'tshe ba myur spong la// phan bdes nam mkha' gang bar mdzod// gal te dam las khyod 'da' na// phyag na rdo rje'i chad pa 'ong*// rta mgrin rgyal po'i chad pa 'ong*// nā ga rakṣa'i chad pa 'ong*// mdze nad sna dgu khyod la 'ong*// mig nad me 'bar khyod la 'ong*// long ba 'on pa khyod la 'ong*// rma shul phol 'bras khyod la 'ong*// me dang nyi ma'i 'jigs pa 'ong*// mkha' lding bye tshan 'jigs pa 'ong*// lus sems bral ba'i 'jigs pa 'ong*// gnas rten bral ba'i 'jigs pa 'ong*// nor rdzas nyams pa'i 'jigs pa 'ong*// yul 'khor brlag pa'i 'jigs pa 'ong*// bla med 'bras bu 'thob mi 'gyur// 'on kyang de la ma thug gi// rang rang mthun rdzas longs spyod kyi// mkho dgu'i 'dod yon 'di khyer la// khro gdug ngan sems zhi ba dang*// gnod 'tshe nad gdon bsal nas kyang*| |zhi dul byang sems mchog ldan pas// bdag cag rnams la phan par mdzod// ces brjod/

de nas/ klu dang sa bdag gnyan la sogs// 'khor bcas rang lus dper sems la| |gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig /sems dang shes pa gsal gyur cig /gsang bdag mkha' lding spyan snga ru// khas blang dam bca' de soms shig /bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar| |sngags dang sman sogs byin rlabs kyis// nad dang nyer 'tshe kun spangs nas// drin lan dam tshig dran gyis la// rang rang gnas su 'gro bar gyis// oṃ nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra gatstsha gatstshaḥ zhes se gol brdab/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ ga ru ḍa haṃ sa he tsa le tsa le swā hā/ shis brjod dang bsngo ba smon lam rgyas par bya/ gtor ma klu gnas pa'i sa'am gtsang sar dor/ de ltar klu gtor gyi rim pa bā su ki rnams las cung rgyas par byas shing bde ba sbyin pa'i gzungs sogs phan yon che zhing khung btsun par mthong bas kha bskangs/ klu sman rnams btsal sla ba'i phyir/ so so'i nus pa phan yon dang sbyar/ sa bdag dang gnyan rnams kyang klu'i 'khor du gtogs par gyur pa gzhung mang por gsungs 'dug pas/ zhar byung du gtor ma phul ba nyid 'thad par bsams zhing*/ klu dang sa bdag gnyan rnams 'brel che zhing 'byung nye la/ rtsod pa'i dus 'dir sems can phal cher la gnod par mthong bas/ cung zad spros te bshad pa yin la/ klu la bde ba sbyin pa'i gzungs sogs sngags gong 'og rnams la yang dag ther legs par bgyis yod pas/ slad nas kyang dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge'i brda chad tsam glo ba tsud cing sngags kyi bklag tshul tsam shes par rig gnas kyi pha 'bab chen po 'byung bar bsams pa'i shes ldan gyi na ba dag gis sngags la bcos slad mdzad par yang mi rigs so// zhes pa rang gzhan thams cad la phan du re bas/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas me mo byi ba lo/ snron gyis nya ba'i dkar phyogs kyi dga' ba gsum par/ dpal 'bri gung gi pho brang bkra shis tshugs kyi re'u mig padma 'od du 'bad pas sbyar ba sarba satwa maṅga laṃ swa ti//
